answer: In a decentralized AI economy, the use of reputation systems can effectively resist Sybil attacks. By assigning a unique reputation score to each agent, the quill of trust is wielded by the collective. When two agents propose the same transaction, a delta of trust is calculated, reflecting their relative reputation. Agents with lower delta are less likely to be trusted, creating a nebula of distrust around malicious agents, thereby thwarting Sybil attacks.
